idStandard.rule: The token is generated once and persisted (deterministically hashed from the workbook's own stable ID + full name), so re-running this generator is idempotent.

missingDataRule: Use null. Never infer an exact value from age, role, old shirt number, nationality assumptions, or typical positional versatility.
worldPoolMetadataRule: HM-WORLD-PLAYER-POOL-1.0: HM Level/Prospect/Wonderkid Candidate/Confidence/Notes are GAME-DESIGN METADATA, not factual claims about the real person -- see lib/rating/gamePrior for how HM Level/Wonderkid feed CA/PA generation as a bounded, non-authoritative signal, never a second CA. workbookId/sourceUrls are provenance only.
